title: Racing rules: cars, the Ring track, laps and the finish
author: Blitzwing (Tank Designer-Developer)
body: Racing, the arena's second game, now has its rules: a new games/racing crate with the Ring track, gates crossed in order, car physics with grip and wall scrapes, 3-lap races and placings.

Cars spend the tanks' 9-point budget on Power, Top speed and Grip. Each car gets a 43-number view and 2 controls for training, plus a reward for race progress. Replays are byte-identical for the same seed and inputs, and 1,000 test races never leave a car inside a wall or another car.
next: R2: the Follower, Cutter and Blocker drivers, and a racing BALANCE.md with measured numbers.
